mission.verdict: CLOSES on its own assumptions: 0.016 c per burn, four burns, 2.80 kt propellant of which the D-He3 share is exactly what 261 TW for 28.6 days needs at 18.35 MeV per reaction; the relativistic correction is 0.08 %.

mass.margin_rule: upper departure envelope less the mission departure mass (the 1.7/1.8 check)
mass.verdict: DOES NOT CLOSE. The mission numbers carry the canon 250 t drive package; the drawn Vertex cluster weighs 6.33 kt (25x that allotment, 1.4x the whole departure mass) and no mission number reads it. Against the 174 t departure margin the A+ additions look small (132 t without the flywheel, 190 t with it), but hardware carried through four burns costs 2.72 kg of departure mass per kg at fixed delta-v, so only 64 t fits the envelope: A+ without the flywheel already needs 360 t.

power.verdict: DOES NOT CLOSE. Canon assumes 80 % of the fusion power leaves as directed exhaust and 4e-5 is absorbed (10.45 GW of the 10.80 GW drive share). The 1.6B source model finds a useful share of 41-44 %, so 476-511 TW of fusion and 4.7-5.0 kt of D-He3 (1.8-2.0x canon fuel); the heat reaching the engine is 12,700x its 2.70 GW share, neutrons alone 10 TW per engine, and a coil shield against them weighs 45 kt for the cluster. These are 3-4 orders of magnitude, not margins.

startup.verdict: OPEN. Charging the four engines' coils takes 38.9 GJ (5.4x the main battery); spread over 31 h it is a 350 kW load the ship bus or the departure station can carry. The first driver pulses need 0.3-15.7 GJ at 31-1,570 MW: the 50 MW pulse bank covers only the lowest bracket, the 58 t flywheel the middle one. Without the flywheel, ignition at the middle bracket has no sourced power path; with it, the mass does not fit. Ignition energy stays OPEN (power.storage.pulse_bank.ignition_energy).

summary.mass: does not close (drawn propulsion 25x its allotment; A+ needs 360 t of departure mass at fixed delta-v, 64 t fits)
summary.power: does not close (absorbed heat 10^3-10^4 x the drive share; realistic fuel 1.8-2.0x canon)
summary.startup: open (ignition power path without the flywheel)
summary.consequence: A+ is affordable relative to the engine it modifies (3 % of its drawn mass) but no A+ choice changes whether the Vertex cluster reaches 0.016 c. The blocking problems are the engine mass, the absorbed heat and the useful power share, together.
